title: One reference page per user-invocable skill, under budget
description: GH-3902: four user-invocable skills (doctor, implement, verify, brainstorm) had generated docs pages over the 25K-token ceiling ora.ai scores, doctor's alone 225 KB. Toggle before and after to see the generator's split mechanism cover all four, including a third level that chunks a single 114 KB reference file by heading with the table header repeated, plus the drift test that now fails on a missing or over-budget user-invocable page.
